citations.assessment: The exact story names Inyani bar Naḥshon and has Ḥanina consider transmitting the Explicit Name. The son’s interruption prevents the transmission.

notes.text: The exact story names Inyani bar Naḥshon and has Ḥanina consider transmitting the Explicit Name. The son’s interruption prevents the transmission.
The narrative reports an intention, not an actual transfer. Its Ḥanina spelling differs slightly from Heilprin’s Ḥinena.
